ghost.name: David Heinemeier Hansson
ghost.subject: Added FormTagHelper that provides a number of methods for creating form tags that doesn't rely on conventions with an object assigned to the template like FormHelper does. With the FormTagHelper, you provide the names and values yourself.

blame.subject: Added :disable_with option to FormTagHelper#submit_tag to allow for easily disabled submit buttons with different text [DHH]
blame.author: David Heinemeier Hansson

quotes.text: Changed the default name of the input tag generated by FormTagHelper#submit_tag from "submit" to "commit" so it doesnt clash with form.submit() calls in Javascript #1271

quotes.text: Added that the html options disabled, readonly, and multiple can all be treated as booleans. So specifying <tt>disabled => :true</tt> will give <tt>disabled="disabled"</tt>. #809 [mindel]
quotes.author: David Heinemeier Hansson
quotes.title: Added that the html options disabled, readonly, and multiple can all be treated as booleans. So specifying <tt>disabled => :true</tt> will give <tt>disabled="disabled"</tt>. #809 [mindel]

medium: These passages reveal the option's origins in accommodating Javascript conflicts, boolean handling, and a shift away from default naming conventions.

case.deletion_subject: Remove `:disable_with` in favor of `'data-disable-with'` option from `submit_tag`, `button_tag` and `button_to` helpers.
